title: Operation 40 becomes Operation Mongoose at JM WAVE

tellings.quote: converted operation 40 into operation mongoose. It's all it did. It set up the big operation on the uh Miami University of Miami campus called JM Wave.

plain: Under Kennedy, a secret anti-Castro group called Operation 40 was turned into Operation Mongoose, a CIA campaign against Cuba, run from a large base on the University of Miami campus called JM WAVE. Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and longtime researcher of government secrets, tells Michels this without naming a source. In his telling, the change was mostly a new name: "It's all it did".
